usdRate.sourceName: Da Afghanistan Bank (transfer buy/sell mid rate)
usdRate.note: Transfer buy 64.96, sell 65.06 AFN per USD.

inflation_cpi.note: August 2026 year on year; secondary source because the NSIA site could not be reached. CPI was -6.6% in 2024 (World Bank).

inflation_projection.sourceName: NSIA CPI via Trading Economics; World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG
inflation_projection.note: Da Afghanistan Bank publishes no inflation target and CPI swung from -6.6% (2024) to 7.8% (Aug 2026), so we plan with a rounded 5% long-run rate.

policy_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank sets no policy rate: interest-based instruments (including capital-note auctions) ended with the move to interest-free banking. Searched DAB site, news, Central Banking.

savings_account_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank ended interest-based banking (all bank business is conducted without interest under Hanafi jurisprudence); no published deposit or profit rates found. Searched DAB, bank sites, news.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank ended interest-based banking (all bank business is conducted without interest under Hanafi jurisprudence); no published deposit or profit rates found. Searched DAB, bank sites, news.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank ended interest-based banking (all bank business is conducted without interest under Hanafi jurisprudence); no published deposit or profit rates found. Searched DAB, bank sites, news.

dps_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank ended interest-based banking (all bank business is conducted without interest under Hanafi jurisprudence); no published deposit or profit rates found. Searched DAB, bank sites, news.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Da Afghanistan Bank ended interest-based banking (all bank business is conducted without interest under Hanafi jurisprudence); no published deposit or profit rates found. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no value for Afghanistan.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond is sold to individuals in Afghanistan.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No treasury bills are issued; DAB capital notes (bank-only) were interest-based and are no longer auctioned.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No government bonds are issued in Afghanistan.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No government bonds are issued in Afghanistan.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Income Tax Law 2009, Article 46 (ARD unofficial translation)
tax_bank_interest.note: Legal persons withhold 20% from interest; in practice banks now pay no interest under the interest ban.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; the Income Tax Law 2009 excludes interest on State bonds from gross income, but no such bonds are issued.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The Afghanistan Deposits Protection Fund (a DAB department) exists, but no per-depositor cover amount could be found; DAB pages returned 403.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card interest cap or typical rate found; interest-based lending is banned.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in afghani terms (no local stock market)
equity_return_low.note: Afghanistan has no stock exchange or retail funds, so equity means a global index held in afghani terms, which can lose value when the afghani strengthens (it rose from about 89 to 65 per dollar since 2022).

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in afghani terms (no local stock market)
equity_return_base.note: With no safe local interest rate (0%), the base is capped at 4 points above it; hard access to global funds and afghani swings justify a low figure.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index in afghani terms (no local stock market)
equity_return_high.note: Roughly the long-run nominal dollar return of global equities with a stable afghani.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Da Afghanistan Bank exchange rates; dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: A strengthening afghani can offset dollar gold gains for years, as in 2022-2026.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Da Afghanistan Bank exchange rates; dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year with little expected afghani depreciation, roughly matching the 5% inflation assumption.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Da Afghanistan Bank exchange rates; dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: Dollar gold strength plus renewed afghani depreciation (it averaged about 5% a year in 2010-2020).

fixed_income_return_low.note: Banks pay no interest and no government securities are sold, so safe money earns nothing.

fixed_income_return_base.note: No interest-bearing deposits or government securities exist for individuals; we assume cash-like safe savings earn 0%.

fixed_income_return_high.note: Allows for modest profit shares on Islamic investment deposits if banks begin publishing them.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry claim settlement data published by the General Directorate of Takaful and Insurance; life insurance volume is negligible (Axco).

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No retail term life market: only one insurer has offered life cover, as a special case (Moore Afghanistan insurance overview); no premium quotes found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No typical private hospital stay cost published; one news anecdote cites AFN 150,000 for a lung surgery at a Kabul private hospital (8am.media), too thin to use.

health_premium_table.note: No retail private health insurance market with published premiums found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series found; we use the 5% inflation assumption plus 2 points for import-dependent medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series found; we use the 5% inflation assumption plus 2 points for private schooling costs.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years = expected age at death by current age minus that age; explainer only.

support_ratio.note: People aged 15-64 per person 65+, computed from the UN WPP 2024 age structure; World Bank old-age dependency 4.41 (2025) gives 22.7.

retirement_age_default.note: Mandatory retirement age for employees is 65; private workers get a lump sum of 10 months' last pay rather than a pension (US SSA, May 2024).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Pajhwok (Labour Law, Article 138; civil service commission)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants: 65 or 40 years of service; a decree extended it by two years in some institutions (Amu TV).

retirement_return_low.note: Safe money earns nothing without interest-bearing deposits or bills.

retirement_return_base.note: Kept at the after-tax safe rate, which is 0% because banks pay no interest and no government securities are sold.

retirement_return_high.note: Allows for a small gold share or Islamic deposit profit.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of cash, gold and global equity (assumption)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: A cash-heavy mix earns nothing in a weak case.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of cash, gold and global equity (assumption)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Balanced mix of 0% cash, 5% gold and 4% global equity in afghani terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of cash, gold and global equity (assumption)
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: Gold and global equity high cases with a stable afghani.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: US Social Security Administration, International Update May 2024
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension; the SSA says Afghanistan lacks any programme giving long-term old-age benefits to many residents (page read via search excerpts; direct fetch blocked).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension exists (US SSA, May 2024), so no eligibility rules.

gratuity_rule.note: No days-per-year gratuity: private employers must pay 10 months of last monthly earnings as a lump sum when a worker leaves at 65 (US SSA, May 2024), which does not fit the per-year rule.

public_pension_scheme.note: The public-sector pension scheme (8% employee, 8% state, age 65) was suspended in 2021 and ended in 2024; payments to about 150,000 existing retirees resumed from Aug 2025 (Arab News), but no scheme takes new members and private workers have never had one.

savings_account.note: Interest-free; banks follow Islamic banking rules and publish no profit rates.

fdr_3m.note: Interest-bearing term deposits ended with the interest ban.

fdr_1y.note: Interest-bearing term deposits ended with the interest ban.

dps.note: No recurring deposit schemes with a stated return.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bills; DAB capital notes were for banks only and are no longer auctioned.

equity_fund.note: No stock exchange or retail mutual funds.

gold.note: Physical gold is widely bought and held.

insuranceRegulator.name: General Directorate of Takaful and Insurance, Ministry of Finance

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Public Health (free care at public hospitals)
publicHealthCover.note: Public hospitals report free surgery; no national health insurance.

depositInsurance.name: Afghanistan Deposits Protection Fund (Da Afghanistan Bank)
